<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>RBI policy tightening:</strong> The Reserve Bank of India raised the repo rate to 5.50% and shifted its stance to &quot;calibrated tightening&quot; to address persistent inflation risks and support a projected 7.1% GDP growth.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxQYlZ1WlVEQVdUTlVnREFSVktCRXZSQTRVTDZsOWY1VjVCdm1hR2Y1bHRTdFBYa3B3c2pGb2lwa1Utb0xmVkJtVEd3WUdxbFFwS0F0akxYMU1tT0QwaUtfZDVUOGtqVTVTbXdUczRabEZRbC15Q1ZmRzlocDc1bWx6a3h2TXg3VnNlNjZ2RGtfUmVtcHdVY2xWcHVnZHlpZF9qdlcxM0FEU0F6VGNvaElKZnh0U2J4Sjg1OF9NWHdpRQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPOUVfOG95VEFzUW9SSldGMmd3T1E4UVFmbF9OSFJCcEN3Q1ZjNzU2WWh4RERxRFdabUFuaV9ydW1IVXJNMmd6RHNxcHhDdlhMbUxTZUJxbWc1MlZHYTRpVzFpT0xVZFl5d1lNeTFCYmhMdFJLc0tISm9nSEFYYXAtYk1aaHFXV1Q2RGNheFMzd3owRmtndEt2UmV4SDY?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I2</a></span></li>
